title: Identity tag fires but session has only autonomy-write loop, no persistence write
description: False-positive guard for §5.3. Repo carries has_identity_rewrite tag (CLAUDE.md rewrites persona); session writes lots of files in autonomous loop but NEVER touches persistent settings. The §5.3 correlator's dynamic side is specifically AI-04.persistence-write or C3.autonomy-with-persistence — generic autonomy-with-exfil-chain doesn't satisfy. This case verifies the precise dynamic-side membership.

m2_expected.rationale: §5.3 dynamic side is {AI-04.persistence-write, C3.autonomy-with-persistence}. C3.autonomy-with-exfil-chain is in the §5.1 set but NOT §5.3. Identity rewrite + non-matching autonomy = no aggregate. This case prevents §5.3 from over-firing on any autonomy finding when identity tag is present.
